_comment: Featured sets: the ones the site highlights and MTG Deck Tools writes a set context for. Every set with phase-rs booster data (GET /api/sets, about 175) can be used for hosted and self-hosted events; a set needs nothing from this list. `primer`: a set context exists (knowledge level "primer"); `ratings`: human play statistics exist (knowledge level "primer+stats" and the human-reference metrics).

not_featured.reason: No set context yet (playable like any other set).
